### 维护者速读

- 可以合：从左右两侧整高滑出的抽屉（消息中心、表单抽屉等）改成直角，不再在屏幕边缘露出弧形缺口；居中弹窗、手机底部面板仍是圆角。只改一条样式，可直接撤回。
- 记录抽屉按你 11-21 的决定改成悬浮卡片（#35854），不在本卡里。要提醒的一点：现在的全局圆角规则带「强制」标记，#35854 做悬浮卡片时会被它盖掉自己的圆角，需要在 #35854 里一并处理。这一点已转给座位记到 #35854 上。

### Must-fix

None.

### Should-fix

- S1 (hand-off, not this diff): the Acceptance note on `!important` is the one fact #35854 needs. A floating record drawer that replaces `inset-y-0` (an inset) is matched by the rule again and takes `1.25rem` whatever its own radius class says. Card #35411's acceptance still lists "记录抽屉的圆角来自它自己的样式" as a pin. When this PR closes #35411, that line moves with the record drawer to #35854. Carry both onto #35854 so neither is lost at close. This is a seat action, not a code change here.

### Checked

- l1-face on `da6a9568`: clean (32 success, 13 expected skip, 0 failed, mergeable clean; `@object-ui/console` changeset present).
- ① Is `.inset-y-0` a stable discriminator? It is the `left`/`right` variants' own class in `sheetVariants` (`top`/`bottom` use `inset-x-0`), so it marks exactly the full-height edge sheets. Its stability comes from the pin: it renders the real `SheetContent` from `@object-ui/components` and matches the DOM against the selector read from the shipped `index.css`. If a Shadcn sync drops `inset-y-0` from the variant, the left/right cases go red. Leaving `sheet.tsx` untouched is right: Commandment #7 makes it a No-Touch zone, and a `data-side` marker would need a declared local patch.
  - Known edge, not a defect: tailwind-merge drops `inset-y-0` when a call site passes a later `inset-y-*` or `inset-*` class. That re-rounds the sheet, which is the right outcome for a floating sheet (#35854). A later `top-*`/`bottom-*` does not drop it. I grepped every `SheetContent` `className`: none overrides `inset-y` or `inset`. The overrides that set height or `rounded-t-2xl` are bottom sheets.
- ② Record drawer: it is still a full-height right Sheet at this head, so it goes square here. That matches the rest of the card until #35854 lands, and the body says so (S1 above).
- Card item 2: centred dialogs, top/bottom sheets and the vaul drawer keep the rule, pinned for top, bottom and the centred dialog.
- Card item 3 ("no leftover rounded trace on border or shadow"): Sheet carries no radius of its own, so border and shadow follow the 0 radius. There is no browser reading, and the body says screenshots were skipped. The two-minute check in the body gives the computed-style reading a reviewer can take.
- The selector reader in the pin finds the single `1.25rem !important` declaration and fails if a second appears. After review it no longer uses a hand-rolled comment strip.
- Changeset: patch; its sentences match the diff (the record drawer is named as square, which is true at this head).

## 席位核对 — delta ACCEPT (L1-b)

Head-sha: 6d88e59bf54593a76495fc30fe31b075433a314d · read 2026-11-21T05:25Z · delta from `da6a9568` (ACCEPT 7057488172)

### 维护者速读

- 可以合：#35854 的悬浮记录抽屉已经进了 main。这次合入 main 后实测，悬浮抽屉在电脑屏幕上用的是它自己的圆角（略小于原来的 20px），不再被全局规则覆盖；手机上它是整屏贴边，和其他贴边抽屉一样是直角。
- 上一轮我担心全局规则会盖掉悬浮抽屉自己的圆角。合入后确认不会，所以这一条不用再记到 #35854 上。

### Delta

- Merge `e4f0273e` (main `f9f45d34`, which includes #35910's floating record drawer from #35854): conflict-free. The net change to `index.css` is identical to `da6a9568`. Only the pin file and the changeset grew.
- Correction to my S1 at `da6a9568`: I said a floating drawer that replaces `inset-y-0` would be matched again and take `1.25rem`. That premise does not hold for the drawer #35854 shipped. `navigation-overlay.tsx` adds `sm:inset-y-2 sm:right-2 sm:rounded-xl` and does not replace the base variant. A responsive-prefixed class is a different tailwind-merge group from the unprefixed one, so `inset-y-0` stays on the element. The rule skips it, and at `sm` and above the drawer's own `sm:rounded-xl` applies. Below `sm` the drawer is full width and full height and renders square, like the other edge sheets. S1 is closed by the new pin, so nothing needs carrying to #35854.
- New `describe` renders the real `NavigationOverlay` in drawer mode. It asserts that the element carrying `data-record-drawer-card` is not matched by the selector read from `index.css`, and that its className contains `sm:rounded-xl`. That second assertion is on the class, because jsdom has no Tailwind, and a comment says so. The body names three ablations that go red.
- Changeset: the record drawer is no longer listed as square. The new sentence ("shows its own corner radius instead of the global one") is true at `sm` and above. Below `sm` its own radius is none.
- Residual edge, not a defect: the host `className` still merges last in drawer mode, so a host passing an unprefixed `inset-*` / `inset-y-*` would drop `inset-y-0` and bring the global radius back. No call site does that today.

### Must-fix / Should-fix

None.

### Owed

- CI at read: 33 success, 0 failed, 1 pending (Check Changeset). This L1 is final once that check is green on `6d88e59b`.
- L1 does not replace an L2.
